title: 心牆土石壩分區填築~Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams
focus: 心牆阻水、反濾排水與分區填築的相容~Compatibility of core sealing, filter drainage and zoned embankment placement
summary: 本課以心牆土石壩分區填築為入口，深入心牆阻水、反濾排水與分區填築的相容。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams as its entry point, this course examines compatibility of core sealing, filter drainage and zoned embankment placement. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 達西敏感度固定平均水力坡降5與通流面積1000 m²，只將k由10⁻⁹增至2×10⁻⁹ m/s。Q=kiA由5×10⁻⁶增至10⁻⁵ m³/s，即0.005增至0.010 L/s，恰為兩倍。這要求同一均質、無裂縫材料內仍可用線性達西流；若提高流量是裂縫或繞流造成，就不能只用調整均質k來解釋。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent. Added water is forty tonnes, excluding evaporation and mixing losses and not a field recipe. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For Darcy sensitivity, hold gradient five and flow area 1000 m² fixed, changing only k from 10⁻⁹ to 2×10⁻⁹ m/s. Q=kiA doubles from 5×10⁻⁶ to 10⁻⁵ m³/s, or 0.005 to 0.010 L/s. This assumes linear Darcy flow in the same homogeneous uncracked medium; increased flow from cracking or bypass cannot be explained solely by adjusting homogeneous k.
history: 心牆土石壩依靠分區材料共同工作，防滲不等於各區都阻水；反濾保持、排水連通和心牆應力狀態共同決定缺陷是否會擴大。反濾層標準章節更新，聚焦顆粒保持與區域界面。 土石壩設計與施工章節更新，連結材料、填築與品質控制。 滲流與監測章節更新，提供服役水壓及行為判讀背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。~Earth-core rockfill dams depend on coordinated zones rather than making every material impermeable. Filter retention, connected drainage and core stress together determine whether defects can progress. The protective-filter standard is updated, emphasizing particle retention and zone interfaces. Embankment design and construction chapters are updated to connect materials, placement and quality control. Seepage and monitoring chapters are updated, supporting interpretation of service pressures and behavior. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

units.anchor: 分區滲透功能~Hydraulic functions of zones
units.title: 分區滲透功能~Hydraulic functions of zones
units.mechanism: 心牆降低滲流，反濾層保持細土，排水層把水安全導出；三者功能不同。把所有區域都做得不透水，可能反而讓下游孔壓無法消散。 假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。 小範圍裂縫可能主導總流量，即使心牆材料滲透率很低。若排水層被細料污染，孔壓會增加而不是變得更安全，必須依各區功能解讀性能。~The core limits flow, filters retain fines and drains safely release water. Their functions differ, and making every zone impermeable can prevent downstream pore pressures from dissipating. Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material. A small crack can dominate flow despite low intact-core permeability. Fines-contaminated drains can raise pressure rather than improve safety, requiring performance to be interpreted according to each zones intended function.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material.
units.verify: 將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。分別列出完整心牆流與缺陷集中流的證據。~Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes. Compare pressure contours and discharge, using crack scenarios to identify paths omitted by the intact-soil Darcy estimate. List intact-core flow evidence separately from concentrated flow through defects.
units.failure: 小範圍裂縫可能主導總流量，即使心牆材料滲透率很低。若排水層被細料污染，孔壓會增加而不是變得更安全，必須依各區功能解讀性能。~A small crack can dominate flow despite low intact-core permeability. Fines-contaminated drains can raise pressure rather than improve safety, requiring performance to be interpreted according to each zones intended function.
units.misconception: 所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。~Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer.
units.practice: 以分區滲透功能編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic functions of zones, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes. Compare pressure contours and discharge, using crack scenarios to identify paths omitted by the intact-soil Darcy estimate.

units.anchor: 含水調整與乾土質量~Moisture adjustment on dry mass
units.title: 含水調整與乾土質量~Moisture adjustment on dry mass
units.mechanism: 心牆含水量以水重除乾土重定義，施工加水須先區分乾土與濕土基準。含水量影響壓實、滲透和施工孔壓，不能只追求最大乾密度。 假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。 表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。材料濕側施工也可能提高短期孔壓，需與穩定需求共同評估。~Core water content is water mass divided by dry-soil mass, so water addition requires a clear dry versus wet basis. Moisture affects compaction, permeability and construction pore pressure rather than density alone. Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent. Added water is forty tonnes, excluding evaporation and mixing losses and not a field recipe. Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean. Using wet mass miscalculates additions, and wetter placement can raise short-term pore pressure, requiring evaluation with stability needs.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent. Added water is forty tonnes, excluding evaporation and mixing losses and not a field recipe.
units.verify: 先由烘乾試驗核對乾土質量，再對不同深度取樣檢查混合均勻；將加水計量與天候損失閉合，並比較壓實後孔壓、強度和滲透試驗而非只有含水平均。在壓實層底重新取樣檢查上濕下乾現象。~Verify dry mass by drying tests and sample several depths for mixing uniformity. Close added water against weather losses and compare post-compaction pore pressure, strength and permeability rather than mean moisture alone. Resample the compacted lift bottom to check for a wet-top dry-bottom profile.
units.failure: 表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。材料濕側施工也可能提高短期孔壓，需與穩定需求共同評估。~Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean. Using wet mass miscalculates additions, and wetter placement can raise short-term pore pressure, requiring evaluation with stability needs.
units.misconception: 用濕土總重量乘含水率差就一定得到正確補水量。~Wet total soil mass times the moisture difference always gives the correct water addition.
units.practice: 以含水調整與乾土質量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。先由烘乾試驗核對乾土質量，再對不同深度取樣檢查混合均勻；將加水計量與天候損失閉合，並比較壓實後孔壓、強度和滲透試驗而非只有含水平均。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for moisture adjustment on dry mass, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Verify dry mass by drying tests and sample several depths for mixing uniformity. Close added water against weather losses and compare post-compaction pore pressure, strength and permeability rather than mean moisture alone.

units.anchor: 密度孔隙與飽和度~Density void ratio and saturation
units.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度~Density void ratio and saturation
units.mechanism: 乾密度與顆粒比重決定孔隙比，再結合含水量可估飽和度。這些相態關係能抓出不合理數據，但不能取代強度與滲透試驗。 此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。假設Gs=2.7、ρd=1800 kg/m³、ρw=1000，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.5；含水率0.15時Sr=wGs/e=0.81。 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。~Dry density and particle specific gravity determine void ratio, which combines with water content to estimate saturation. Phase relations detect inconsistent data without replacing strength or permeability testing. Water density here is 1000 kg/m³. Assume Gs=2.7, dry density 1800 kg/m³ and water density 1000. Void ratio is 0.5; at water content 0.15, saturation Sr=wGs/e=0.81. Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。假設Gs=2.7、ρd=1800 kg/m³、ρw=1000，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.5；含水率0.15時Sr=wGs/e=0.81。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Water density here is 1000 kg/m³. Assume Gs=2.7, dry density 1800 kg/m³ and water density 1000. Void ratio is 0.5; at water content 0.15, saturation Sr=wGs/e=0.81.
units.verify: 同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。以體積和質量閉合檢查取樣體積是否失真。~Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one. Investigate units, coarse-particle corrections and sample volume before interpreting spatial variation. Use volume-mass closure to check whether the sampling volume is distorted.
units.failure: 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。~Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation.
units.misconception: 乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。~Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids.
units.practice: 以密度孔隙與飽和度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for density void ratio and saturation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one. Investigate units, coarse-particle corrections and sample volume before interpreting spatial variation.

units.anchor: 水力劈裂與小主應力~Hydraulic fracture and minor stress
units.title: 水力劈裂與小主應力~Hydraulic fracture and minor stress
units.mechanism: 心牆若因拱效應使小主壓應力降低，蓄水壓力可能沿弱面推開土體。簡單總應力比較只能提示敏感性，實際起裂還取決於抗拉、缺陷和應力路徑。 假設局部總小主壓應力250 kPa、水壓220 kPa，差30 kPa；若拱效應降低總應力50 kPa，差變−20 kPa，僅無抗拉篩選。 以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。只比單一水壓數字，不能確定劈裂位置或後續內部侵蝕。~Arching can reduce the core minor compressive stress, allowing reservoir pressure to open weak planes. A simple total-stress comparison indicates sensitivity; initiation also depends on tension resistance, defects and stress history. Assume local total minor compression 250 kPa and water pressure 220 kPa, leaving 30 kPa. Reducing total stress by 50 kPa gives −20 kPa, a zero-tension screening comparison only. Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設局部總小主壓應力250 kPa、水壓220 kPa，差30 kPa；若拱效應降低總應力50 kPa，差變−20 kPa，僅無抗拉篩選。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume local total minor compression 250 kPa and water pressure 220 kPa, leaving 30 kPa. Reducing total stress by 50 kPa gives −20 kPa, a zero-tension screening comparison only.
units.verify: 核對量測的是總應力還是有效應力，將孔壓和土壓計布置到同層位；比較蓄水前後應力路徑，並用裂縫、漏流與反濾保護證據一起判讀敏感區。檢查最小主應力方向是否與假設裂縫面相符。~Identify total versus effective stress and colocate pressure and earth-pressure observations by layer. Compare pre- and post-filling stress paths and interpret sensitive zones using cracks, seepage and filter protection together. Check whether the minor-principal-stress direction matches the assumed fracture plane.
units.failure: 以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。只比單一水壓數字，不能確定劈裂位置或後續內部侵蝕。~Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion.
units.misconception: 只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。~Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.
units.practice: 以水力劈裂與小主應力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對量測的是總應力還是有效應力，將孔壓和土壓計布置到同層位；比較蓄水前後應力路徑，並用裂縫、漏流與反濾保護證據一起判讀敏感區。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic fracture and minor stress, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify total versus effective stress and colocate pressure and earth-pressure observations by layer. Compare pre- and post-filling stress paths and interpret sensitive zones using cracks, seepage and filter protection together.

units.anchor: 心牆拱效應與沉降差~Core arching and differential settlement
units.title: 心牆拱效應與沉降差~Core arching and differential settlement
units.mechanism: 較軟心牆與較硬壩殼變形不同，界面剪力可把部分豎向荷載轉移到兩側。這有時降低心牆壓應力，不能把荷載轉移一律視為有利。 假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。 窄谷或陡峭岸坡容易形成複雜三維拱效應，單一二維係數可能不足。若只以心牆壓力降低當作減載好處，會忽略裂縫與水力劈裂敏感性提高。~A softer core and stiffer shells settle differently, allowing interface shear to transfer vertical load sideways. Reduced core compression can be unfavorable, so load transfer is not automatically beneficial. Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25. Remaining stress is 450 kPa, an assumed load split rather than a universal arching coefficient. Narrow valleys and steep abutments create three-dimensional arching beyond one two-dimensional coefficient. Viewing reduced core stress only as beneficial unloading overlooks increased sensitivity to cracking and hydraulic fracture.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25. Remaining stress is 450 kPa, an assumed load split rather than a universal arching coefficient.
units.verify: 比較心牆和壩殼分層沉降、土壓與孔壓，檢查荷載是否按界面方向轉移；用不同剛度比模型測試局部低應力區，並核對施工高差的時間歷程。比較陡岸與谷底區域的應力轉移差異。~Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction. Test low-stress zones across stiffness ratios and retain the history of construction elevation differences. Compare stress-transfer behavior near steep abutments with the valley-center region.
units.failure: 窄谷或陡峭岸坡容易形成複雜三維拱效應，單一二維係數可能不足。若只以心牆壓力降低當作減載好處，會忽略裂縫與水力劈裂敏感性提高。~Narrow valleys and steep abutments create three-dimensional arching beyond one two-dimensional coefficient. Viewing reduced core stress only as beneficial unloading overlooks increased sensitivity to cracking and hydraulic fracture.
units.misconception: 心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。~Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance.
units.practice: 以心牆拱效應與沉降差編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較心牆和壩殼分層沉降、土壓與孔壓，檢查荷載是否按界面方向轉移；用不同剛度比模型測試局部低應力區，並核對施工高差的時間歷程。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for core arching and differential settlement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction. Test low-stress zones across stiffness ratios and retain the history of construction elevation differences.

units.anchor: 反濾保持與排水能力~Filter retention and drainage capacity
units.title: 反濾保持與排水能力~Filter retention and drainage capacity
units.mechanism: 反濾材料要保持心牆細粒又提供足夠通水性，兩條要求需同時滿足。粒徑比只是初步條件，分散性土與間斷級配需要專門試驗。 假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。 施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。只用料場平均曲線可能同時漏掉這兩種相反缺陷，不能代替鋪設連續性和界面驗證。~Filters must retain core particles while providing adequate flow capacity, requiring both conditions. Grain-size ratios are preliminary checks, while dispersive soils and gap grading require dedicated testing. Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. A separate assumed k=10⁻⁴ m/s is not derived from that ratio or an acceptance criterion. Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage. A stockpile-average curve can miss both opposing defects and cannot replace checks of placement continuity and zone interfaces.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. A separate assumed k=10⁻⁴ m/s is not derived from that ratio or an acceptance criterion.
units.verify: 按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。用出水細料量判斷是否出現持續顆粒遷移。~Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination. Test retention and clogging under concentrated defect flow, preserving particle discharge, time and head-difference records. Use discharged-fines mass to determine whether particle migration continues over time.
units.failure: 施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。只用料場平均曲線可能同時漏掉這兩種相反缺陷，不能代替鋪設連續性和界面驗證。~Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage. A stockpile-average curve can miss both opposing defects and cannot replace checks of placement continuity and zone interfaces.
units.misconception: 反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。~A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient.
units.practice: 以反濾保持與排水能力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for filter retention and drainage capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination. Test retention and clogging under concentrated defect flow, preserving particle discharge, time and head-difference records.

units.anchor: 排水帶流量與水頭~Drain flow and hydraulic head
units.title: 排水帶流量與水頭~Drain flow and hydraulic head
units.mechanism: 排水帶需把滲流導出而不累積高孔壓，其能力取決於滲透率、斷面和水力坡降。出水端堵塞或尾水升高也會改變系統，不能只看材料試驗k值。 假設排水k=0.01 m/s、通流面積2 m²、坡降0.05，Q=kiA=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s；穩定飽和達西流，未含出口損失。 高流量時粗料可能出現非達西效應，出口被淹也會降低實際坡降。若把設計名義斷面當永遠有效，會高估經沉降與細料遷移後的排水能力。~A drain must transmit seepage without building high pore pressure. Capacity depends on permeability, area and gradient, while outlet blockage or tailwater changes the system beyond the material permeability value. Assume drain k=0.01 m/s, flow area 2 m² and gradient 0.05. Q=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s, for steady saturated Darcy flow without outlet loss. Coarse drains can become non-Darcy at high flow, and submerged outlets reduce gradients. Treating nominal section as permanently effective overstates capacity after settlement and fines migration alter the flow paths.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設排水k=0.01 m/s、通流面積2 m²、坡降0.05，Q=kiA=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s；穩定飽和達西流，未含出口損失。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume drain k=0.01 m/s, flow area 2 m² and gradient 0.05. Q=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s, for steady saturated Darcy flow without outlet loss.
units.verify: 沿排水帶量測水頭並核對出口尾水，對照集水流量和降雨；檢查通流面積是否被壓縮或污染縮小，再以不同水頭下資料確認線性達西假設是否合理。將出口淹沒情境下的有效坡降重新計算。~Measure heads along the drain and check outlet tailwater against collected flow and rain. Inspect reduced area from deformation or contamination and use several heads to test the linear Darcy assumption. Recalculate effective gradients for the scenario with a submerged drain outlet.
units.failure: 高流量時粗料可能出現非達西效應，出口被淹也會降低實際坡降。若把設計名義斷面當永遠有效，會高估經沉降與細料遷移後的排水能力。~Coarse drains can become non-Darcy at high flow, and submerged outlets reduce gradients. Treating nominal section as permanently effective overstates capacity after settlement and fines migration alter the flow paths.
units.misconception: 排水料滲透係數很高就保證任何出口條件下都能充分排水。~High drain permeability guarantees sufficient drainage under every outlet condition.
units.practice: 以排水帶流量與水頭編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿排水帶量測水頭並核對出口尾水，對照集水流量和降雨；檢查通流面積是否被壓縮或污染縮小，再以不同水頭下資料確認線性達西假設是否合理。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for drain flow and hydraulic head, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure heads along the drain and check outlet tailwater against collected flow and rain. Inspect reduced area from deformation or contamination and use several heads to test the linear Darcy assumption.

units.anchor: 分區方量與邊界污染~Zone volumes and boundary contamination
units.title: 分區方量與邊界污染~Zone volumes and boundary contamination
units.mechanism: 分區填築的空間邊界維持不同材料的功能，推土機越界和運輸掉料可能造成混雜。總材料量正確不能證明反濾帶厚度或心牆連續性正確。 假設一層心牆長200 m、寬6 m、厚0.25 m，方量300 m³；兩側各混入0.1 m寬帶則受影響10 m³，占3.333%。 局部混料占比小仍可能沿整條反濾帶形成堵塞，心牆被粗粒貫穿也可增加缺陷。若只按各料區進場重量驗收，空間錯位會被總量平衡掩蓋。~Zoned placement preserves distinct material functions through spatial boundaries. Equipment crossing and spillage mix materials, so correct total quantities do not establish filter thickness or core continuity. Assume core lift length 200 m, width 6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 300 m³. Mixed bands 0.1 m wide on both sides affect 10 m³, or 3.333 percent. A small mixed fraction can clog a continuous filter strip, while coarse intrusion damages the core. Acceptance based only on incoming material mass allows spatial misplacement to hide behind a correct total balance.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層心牆長200 m、寬6 m、厚0.25 m，方量300 m³；兩側各混入0.1 m寬帶則受影響10 m³，占3.333%。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core lift length 200 m, width 6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 300 m³. Mixed bands 0.1 m wide on both sides affect 10 m³, or 3.333 percent.
units.verify: 用測量線、照片與批次標記核對每層分區位置，抽查界面粒徑而非只取中間；將跨區車行和材料外溢事件映射到收方面，確認相鄰層邊界連續。以界面剖面照片核對反濾帶連續厚度。~Use survey lines, photographs and batch labels to verify each lift boundary and sample interfaces rather than centers only. Map crossing traffic and spillage to as-built surfaces and check continuity between successive zones. Check continuous filter thickness against photographs of the actual zone interface.
units.failure: 局部混料占比小仍可能沿整條反濾帶形成堵塞，心牆被粗粒貫穿也可增加缺陷。若只按各料區進場重量驗收，空間錯位會被總量平衡掩蓋。~A small mixed fraction can clog a continuous filter strip, while coarse intrusion damages the core. Acceptance based only on incoming material mass allows spatial misplacement to hide behind a correct total balance.
units.misconception: 各分區材料總重量正確就能證明所有分區位置與厚度正確。~Correct total material mass proves every zone is correctly located and dimensioned.
units.practice: 以分區方量與邊界污染編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用測量線、照片與批次標記核對每層分區位置，抽查界面粒徑而非只取中間；將跨區車行和材料外溢事件映射到收方面，確認相鄰層邊界連續。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for zone volumes and boundary contamination, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use survey lines, photographs and batch labels to verify each lift boundary and sample interfaces rather than centers only. Map crossing traffic and spillage to as-built surfaces and check continuity between successive zones.

units.anchor: 施工孔壓與載重速率~Construction pore pressure and loading rate
units.title: 施工孔壓與載重速率~Construction pore pressure and loading rate
units.mechanism: 快速加高會讓低滲透心牆來不及排水，新增總應力部分轉為孔壓。施工穩定必須使用相符的排水條件，不能以長期有效應力強度直接取代短期分析。 假設新增總應力100 kPa、量測孔壓增加70 kPa，該增量的有效應力增加30 kPa；以Δσ′=Δσ−Δu計，不等同整體ru。 儀器反應遲緩可能低估真正孔壓峰值，停工後仍在消散則說明長期狀態尚未建立。若把總應力增加全部當有效壓密，會高估即時抗剪能力。~Rapid raising can load a low-permeability core faster than it drains, converting part of added total stress into pore pressure. Construction stability requires matching drainage conditions rather than substituting long-term behavior. Assume added total stress 100 kPa and measured pore-pressure increase 70 kPa. Effective stress increases 30 kPa by Δσ′=Δσ−Δu, not a whole-dam ru value. Slow instruments can understate true pressure peaks, while continued dissipation shows long-term conditions are not established. Treating all added total stress as effective compression overstates immediate shear resistance.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新增總應力100 kPa、量測孔壓增加70 kPa，該增量的有效應力增加30 kPa；以Δσ′=Δσ−Δu計，不等同整體ru。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume added total stress 100 kPa and measured pore-pressure increase 70 kPa. Effective stress increases 30 kPa by Δσ′=Δσ−Δu, not a whole-dam ru value.
units.verify: 將每層填築重量、時間與孔壓歷線對齊，分辨載重上升和停工消散；核對土壓計及孔壓計零點，並以排水距離與材料滲透性檢查反應時間合理性。比對停工後孔壓消散曲線與施工載重紀錄。~Align lift weight and timing with pore-pressure histories, separating loading from dissipation during pauses. Check pressure-instrument zeros and assess response time using drainage distance and material permeability. Compare post-pause pressure dissipation curves against the recorded construction loading history.
units.failure: 儀器反應遲緩可能低估真正孔壓峰值，停工後仍在消散則說明長期狀態尚未建立。若把總應力增加全部當有效壓密，會高估即時抗剪能力。~Slow instruments can understate true pressure peaks, while continued dissipation shows long-term conditions are not established. Treating all added total stress as effective compression overstates immediate shear resistance.
units.misconception: 新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。~All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress.
units.practice: 以施工孔壓與載重速率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將每層填築重量、時間與孔壓歷線對齊，分辨載重上升和停工消散；核對土壓計及孔壓計零點，並以排水距離與材料滲透性檢查反應時間合理性。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for construction pore pressure and loading rate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align lift weight and timing with pore-pressure histories, separating loading from dissipation during pauses. Check pressure-instrument zeros and assess response time using drainage distance and material permeability.

units.anchor: 快速退水與支承改變~Rapid drawdown and lost support
units.title: 快速退水與支承改變~Rapid drawdown and lost support
units.mechanism: 退水移除上游水體支承，但心牆與坡體孔壓可能來不及下降。外部水位低不代表內部已排水，穩定分析需使用時間相關的孔壓場。 假設某點總正應力180 kPa、退水後孔壓仍120 kPa，有效60 kPa；若誤假設孔壓已降40 kPa，會估140 kPa，高估2.333倍。 把退水後的最低庫位配上早已消散的孔壓會形成不真實荷載組合，忽略外水支承消失又會偏樂觀。慢速表面排水不能代表深部弱層同樣迅速排水。~Drawdown removes external upstream support while internal pore pressures can lag. Low reservoir level does not establish drained soil, so stability requires a time-dependent internal pressure field. Assume total normal stress 180 kPa and retained pore pressure 120 kPa, giving effective stress 60 kPa. Assuming pressure already fell to 40 kPa gives 140 kPa, an overestimate by factor 2.333. Combining minimum reservoir level with fully dissipated pressures can create an unrealistic load case, while retaining lost external support is optimistic. Surface drainage does not establish equally rapid drainage in deep weak layers.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某點總正應力180 kPa、退水後孔壓仍120 kPa，有效60 kPa；若誤假設孔壓已降40 kPa，會估140 kPa，高估2.333倍。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total normal stress 180 kPa and retained pore pressure 120 kPa, giving effective stress 60 kPa. Assuming pressure already fell to 40 kPa gives 140 kPa, an overestimate by factor 2.333.
units.verify: 比較水庫退水率與坡內各深度孔壓消散，確認量測點涵蓋可能滑面；用同一時間截面重建外水支承與內部壓力，並對排水速度和土體強度做敏感度。把外水支承消失與內部孔壓消散分別建模。~Compare reservoir drawdown with pore-pressure dissipation at several depths and cover plausible slip surfaces. Reconstruct external support and internal pressure at the same instant and test drainage-rate and strength sensitivity. Model loss of external water support separately from internal pressure dissipation.
units.failure: 把退水後的最低庫位配上早已消散的孔壓會形成不真實荷載組合，忽略外水支承消失又會偏樂觀。慢速表面排水不能代表深部弱層同樣迅速排水。~Combining minimum reservoir level with fully dissipated pressures can create an unrealistic load case, while retaining lost external support is optimistic. Surface drainage does not establish equally rapid drainage in deep weak layers.
units.misconception: 水庫退到低水位時，壩內所有孔壓必定已同步降到最低。~At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum.
units.practice: 以快速退水與支承改變編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較水庫退水率與坡內各深度孔壓消散，確認量測點涵蓋可能滑面；用同一時間截面重建外水支承與內部壓力，並對排水速度和土體強度做敏感度。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rapid drawdown and lost support, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare reservoir drawdown with pore-pressure dissipation at several depths and cover plausible slip surfaces. Reconstruct external support and internal pressure at the same instant and test drainage-rate and strength sensitivity.

facts: 教學均質完整心牆達西流量0.005 L/s。~Teaching homogeneous intact-core Darcy flow is 0.005 L/s.
教學乾土1000 t調整含水需加水40 t。~Teaching moisture adjustment for dry soil 1000 t needs 40 t water.
教學孔隙比0.5、含水率0.15得到飽和度0.81。~Teaching void ratio 0.5 and water content 0.15 give saturation 0.81.
教學局部應力折減後水壓差為−20 kPa，僅篩選。~Teaching reduced local stress-pressure difference is −20 kPa, a screening result only.
教學排水帶達西能力1 L/s，未含出口損失。~Teaching drain Darcy capacity is 1 L/s, excluding outlet losses.
教學施工總應力增100 kPa而有效應力僅增30 kPa。~Teaching total stress rises 100 kPa while effective stress rises only 30 kPa.
